text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The newspaper prints Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea's report on the government's reform programme presented on Monday.
- Commercial banks are still awaiting the green light from the central bank to act as dealers on the interbank market.
- German foreign minister Klaus Kinkel is expected to visit Bucharest on April 30, the paper says.
- The government is ready to face problems generated by high unemployment, the paper quotes state secretary Dorin Nicolae as saying.
- Local politicians across the political spectrum say they support the reform programme presented by Ciorbea.
- Fuel prices rose to 2,900 per litre of premium petrol and to 2,500 lei for a litre of diesel oil.
